summary: R227 preserves source-log provenance for DX11 startup-census and bootstrap-probe evidence across multi-session analyzer inputs. Startup and bootstrap records now identify the originating log, preventing adapter/format/bootstrap evidence from different runs from becoming unattributable when several logs are analyzed together.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered GitHub vr-dx11-native-r71 HEAD da123ec1f2c1adf971477f76e8c49e094f4316bd. Read AGENTS.md, VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_INDEX.md and Set05, QUEUE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md, CONVERSION_LANE_STATE.json, VR_AUTODEV_STATE.json, VR_RUN_STATE.md, VR_REGRESSION_KNOWLEDGE.json, VR_PROBLEM_HISTORY.md, prior CONVERSION-DX11-00325 record and recent Issue #14 ledger. R226 is durable and was not repeated.

C1_REVIEW.finding: R225 source-scoped per-signature evidence and R226 source-scoped periodic summaries, but Startup and Bootstrap remained global lists whose entries carried no source_log. Multi-log reports therefore could not attribute source format/size/MSAA/bootstrap compatibility, feature level, readiness or selected adapter LUID to the originating session.

review_lenses.architecture: Keep the fix inside the offline DX11 census analyzer/test/verifier; no runtime renderer, OpenXR, DX9Ex or native draw routing changes.
review_lenses.stereo_correctness: No WVP, projection, HUD, sky/effect or recenter behavior change.
review_lenses.performance: Offline report metadata only; runtime hot path unchanged.
review_lenses.adversarial: Two logs deliberately carry different size/format/MSAA/readiness/feature-level/LUID values. Pre-fix output lacks source_log on both evidence families; post-fix assertions require exact attribution.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Startup parser now creates startup_entry and attaches source_log; bootstrap parser does the same before appending. Added a two-log regression fixture with divergent startup/bootstrap identities and source-graph drift guards.

C3_VALIDATE.evidence: TDD RED on base HEAD showed HAS_STARTUP_PROVENANCE=False and HAS_BOOTSTRAP_PROVENANCE=False for two logs with distinct startup/bootstrap identities. GREEN local auxiliary validation passed py_compile, test_analyze_dx11_census.py, verify_dx11_source_graph.py, verify_dx11_activation_boundary.py, verify_dx11_dual_source_contract.py, verify_dx11_native_transport_contract.py, verify_vr_backend_disasm_contract.py, test_dx11_static_surface_contract.py, dx11_native_static_surface_contract_check.py, verify_vr_proven_baseline.py (44 guards), and git diff --check. Exact published source blobs are required to match the locally validated blobs.
